stages.title: Prologue
stages.note: Opening heist and the first hours in Leonida; no free roam yet, so finish story beats before exploring.

stages.title: Ambrosia
stages.note: Small-town opening act; side jobs unlock here and a few are easy to outrun permanently.

stages.title: Grassrivers
stages.note: Swamp country with airboat traversal; several collectibles sit behind timed story gates.

stages.title: Port Gellhorn
stages.note: Industrial docks and cargo yards; stealth-friendly, with vehicle spawns that matter for stunt challenges.

stages.title: Leonida Keys
stages.note: Island chain reachable by boat or plane; the longest travel legs in the campaign live here.

stages.title: Vice City
stages.note: The main hub; most activities, races and online content are concentrated in this stage.

stages.title: Mount Kalaga
stages.note: Mountain and parkland region; climbing routes and off-road collectibles only spawn after the story visit.

stages.title: Whetstone
stages.note: Rural north with dirt tracks and weapon challenges; good place to clean up combat trophies.

stages.title: The Heist
stages.note: Point of no return for the main story; wrap up any missable side content before committing.

stages.title: Epilogue
stages.note: Post-story free roam with everything unlocked; the only stage where a few trophies become obtainable.

trophies.name: Platinum Trophy
trophies.description: Collect every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically once the remaining seventeen trophies on this list are earned. Leave the epilogue cleanup for last, since a handful of collectibles and challenges only spawn after the story closes. Track progress from the pause menu trophy tab rather than guessing.
trophies.why: It is the completion capstone and cannot be earned before every other trophy is done.
steps: Finish the main story through the Epilogue.
Clear all story, side, collectible, challenge and online trophies.
Recheck the trophy list for anything still locked.

trophies.name: Welcome to Leonida
trophies.guide: Story progress unlocks this at the end of the opening heist sequence. Play it straight and do not restart checkpoints, since the trophy is awarded on the final cutscene. It is impossible to skip.
trophies.why: It is the first guaranteed story milestone of the campaign.
steps: Play through the opening heist.
Finish the escape sequence without reloading a checkpoint.

trophies.name: Welcoming Committee
trophies.description: Complete every story mission in Ambrosia.
trophies.guide: Finish the Ambrosia mission chain before the map pushes you toward Grassrivers. The final mission awards the trophy as the stage transition cutscene begins. No optional objectives are required.
trophies.why: It closes out the second story stage and is easy to miss only if you rush the main path.
steps: Complete all Ambrosia story missions.
Watch for the stage transition cutscene to trigger the award.

trophies.name: Local Hero
trophies.description: Complete three Ambrosia side jobs before leaving the region.
trophies.guide: Three of the Ambrosia side jobs disappear once the Grassrivers stage begins, so do them first. They appear as blue markers around the town and take roughly ten minutes each. Check the map after every story mission to catch new ones.
trophies.why: The jobs are removed from the world permanently when the story advances past Ambrosia.
steps: Talk to blue-marker job givers in Ambrosia.
Complete any three before starting Grassrivers.
Confirm the counter in the activity menu.

trophies.name: Swamp Thing
trophies.description: Complete the Grassrivers airboat chase without damaging the boat.
trophies.guide: The chase is a Grassrivers side activity that can be replayed from the activity menu, so a failed attempt costs nothing but time. Hug the inside line through the mangroves and avoid clipping the wooden posts. Restarting from the menu is faster than reloading a checkpoint.
trophies.why: It rewards clean driving rather than completion, which most players miss on the first pass.
steps: Start the airboat chase from the activity menu.
Stay off the banks and wooden posts for the entire run.
Finish the chase to bank the trophy.

trophies.name: Gator Bait
trophies.description: Survive a full night in the Grassrivers wetlands.
trophies.guide: Stay in the wetlands from dusk until dawn without leaving the region or dying. The timer only counts while you are on foot or in a boat, not in a fast-travel menu. Bring a rifle for the wildlife encounters that spawn after midnight.
trophies.why: It is a hidden survival challenge that never appears on the map.
steps: Enter the wetlands just before dusk.
Remain in the region on foot or by boat until sunrise.
Avoid dying to wildlife or law enforcement.

trophies.name: Port of Call
trophies.description: Complete the Port Gellhorn story missions.
trophies.guide: Push through the dockyard mission chain to the crane finale. The trophy appears when the last mission's results screen closes. Stealth approaches are optional and do not affect the award.
trophies.why: It is a straight story milestone with no failure conditions.
steps: Complete every Port Gellhorn story mission.
Finish the crane finale mission.

trophies.name: Keys to the City
trophies.description: Complete the Leonida Keys story arc.
trophies.guide: Fly or sail to the Keys and work through the island missions in order. The arc ends with a plane sequence that awards the trophy on landing. Keep a boat stored near the airstrip so you are not stranded between missions.
trophies.why: It is the longest travel-gated story stage and unlocks the Vice City arc.
steps: Travel to the Leonida Keys and start the first island mission.
Complete the arc through the final plane landing.

trophies.name: Vice Squad
trophies.description: Complete the main Vice City story missions.
trophies.guide: This covers the bulk of the campaign and takes the longest of any single story trophy. Finish every Vice City mission before starting Mount Kalaga, because the story gates the mountain region behind the final Vice City job. Use the safehouse garages to keep mission vehicles intact between attempts.
trophies.why: It is the campaign's central story arc and the largest single time investment.
steps: Complete all Vice City main story missions.
Finish the final downtown job to unlock Mount Kalaga.

trophies.name: Kalaga Climber
trophies.description: Reach the summit of Mount Kalaga on foot.
trophies.guide: Follow the marked climbing trail from the ranger station rather than attempting the rock face directly. The summit marker only registers when you arrive on foot, so leave the helicopter at the base. Pick up the trailhead cache on the way to finish the climb in one trip.
trophies.why: It combines a traversal challenge with the region's trailhead collectible.
steps: Start at the Mount Kalaga ranger station.
Follow the climbing trail on foot to the summit marker.
Grab the trailhead cache along the route.

trophies.name: Whetstone Sharpener
trophies.description: Win every weapon challenge in Whetstone.
trophies.guide: The four Whetstone shooting challenges are replayable from the activity menu and each has a par time. Winning means beating par, not simply finishing, so practise the reload timing. Do them after the story hands you the rifle, since two challenges require it.
trophies.why: Par-time requirements make this far harder than a simple completion trophy.
steps: Unlock the rifle through the story.
Complete all four Whetstone weapon challenges under par.

trophies.name: The Big Score
trophies.guide: This is the point-of-no-return mission chain, so save any missable side content first. Play the approach you have prepared for; both routes award the same trophy. The award lands after the final escape, not at the planning screen.
trophies.why: It is the campaign climax and permanently closes off earlier side content.
steps: Finish all missable side content before starting.
Complete the heist planning and the final escape.

trophies.name: Epilogue
trophies.guide: Finish the short epilogue mission chain to roll credits and unlock full free roam. The trophy appears with the credits sequence and cannot be missed. Afterward every region, activity and online mode is available for cleanup.
trophies.why: It is the final story trophy and the gateway to endgame cleanup.
steps: Complete the epilogue missions.
Watch the credits through to the end.

trophies.name: Penny Pincher
trophies.description: Earn a million dollars from side activities alone.
trophies.guide: Only side-activity payouts count, so story mission rewards and heist cuts do not help. Repeat the high-payout taxi and delivery jobs in Vice City, which are the fastest reliable income. Check the earnings breakdown in the stats menu to confirm you are on track.
trophies.why: It requires deliberate grinding rather than natural story progression.
steps: Run taxi and delivery side jobs in Vice City.
Repeat until side-activity earnings pass one million dollars.
Verify the total in the stats menu.

trophies.name: Wanted: Dead or Alive
trophies.description: Survive a five-star wanted level for two minutes.
trophies.guide: Reach five stars in downtown Vice City, then hold the level for two full minutes without dying or escaping. A helicopter and a fast car make the alley loops around the docks survivable. Do not enter a safehouse or the level clears and the timer resets.
trophies.why: It demands deliberate survival under maximum police pressure.
steps: Reach a five-star wanted level downtown.
Stay wanted for two minutes without dying or hiding.
Escape or get arrested only after the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Stuntman
trophies.guide: Stunt jumps are scattered across every region and remain available in free roam, so this is pure cleanup. Use a fast sports car and approach each ramp at full speed from the marked run-up. The activity menu tracks the count, which is easier than hunting the map icons.
trophies.why: Thirty jumps across the whole map is a long grind that no story path covers.
steps: Open the activity menu and note the jump checklist.
Clear all thirty stunt jumps with a sports car.
Confirm the counter reads 30 of 30.

trophies.name: Collector's Item
trophies.description: Find all fifty hidden packages across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Packages are spread across all ten regions and a few sit inside areas that only open after the story. Sweep region by region using the in-game collectible map rather than wandering. The counter in the pause menu updates immediately when you pick one up.
trophies.why: It is the game's largest collectible set and spans every region.
steps: Unlock full free roam in the Epilogue.
Sweep each region with the collectible map.
Pick up all fifty packages.

trophies.name: Leonida Online
trophies.description: Complete your first online session in Vice City.
trophies.guide: Load into an online session once Vice City is unlocked and finish any single activity to register the trophy. A quick race against other players is the fastest route. Connection drops during the tutorial do not count, so let the intro finish.
trophies.why: It is the only trophy that requires the online mode rather than the campaign.
steps: Unlock Vice City in the story.
Join an online session.
Complete one online activity.
